title: Japanese and Chinese UI text: the rule rows of the egress page and the menu's name were English; its rows read None
note: basis 'shown' means shown by rendering the page in ja and zh-TW in the card's test; the scan reads the pages the wording walk reaches and every template, not every state of every page.

findings.claim: the rule table of /admin/egress (the state and the sentence of each route and of the tripwire) was written in English by tb_common.egress_edge.doctor_checks on a ja or zh-TW page; no catalogue held it, so text_keys could not see it
the departure rows of /admin/egress and /audit/published read the audit detail through the shown filter, which keeps neither route, result nor reason, so every row said None for its route and result
the menu's aria-label is the English word main on every page in every language; not changed: tests match it on ja and zh-TW pages
